integrity.evidence_type: self-contained mathematical proof with exact finite-prime-field checks

scientific_limitations: The support count is for canonical block-marked graphs, not unlabelled digraph isomorphism types in general.
It assumes exactly one dependent pair of squares and independent other square representatives; it does not cover arbitrary corank-one evolution algebras.
General orthogonal natural-basis parameterization and block quotient graph were already known, and are explicitly credited.
Priority over unindexed specialized literature and independent mathematical validation remain unresolved.
title: Sharp finite-field graph-support spectrum for a single square-dependence pair
